method: AI-assisted close reading, not independent human annotation.

records.observation: Unrequested introductory phrase. Strong compression removes evidence-quality and adverse-event qualifications, although uncertainty about some outcomes remains.
RCTs, HES and OHSS unexpanded. No evidence of an effect on pregnancy rates becomes had no effect, strengthening the conclusion.
